record.question: Which of the following is a naturally occurring radioactive primordial nuclide with an extremely long half-life, making it a major contributor to natural background radiation?
record.explanation: Answer B: Uranium-238. Uranium-238 is a naturally occurring primordial radionuclide with an extremely long half-life. Reference: https://www.nist.gov/pml/periodic-table-elements; https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
